to find new people and bring them into a company
a written account of something that has been studied or done
to invite guests and give them food and drink, often for business
a question you ask in order to get information

items: ✓ say what a job involves — My job is to… One of my main roles is to…
✓ use the infinitive after an adjective — It’s important to… It’s difficult to…
✓ use to + verb to say why you did something
✓ choose between to + verb and verb + -ing
✓ talk about responsibilities and ways of working — in charge of, remote, hybrid, recruit, paperwork
✓ say how long you have done it recycled — I’ve been in charge of the team since March
